You woke on the road with Lattice-light in your veins and no memory of the night before. Harrowford's elder wants to see you.
The dead walk the crypt road at night. Thin their numbers before they reach the farms.
Boars are rooting through Millbrook's fields. Drive them off and Tobin will make it worth your while.
Wolves have been taking sheep. Bring back pelts as proof.
Something old commands the dead from the crypt east of town. End it.

The forest is choking on its own growth. Thin it.
Our healers need duskcap. It grows in shadowed hollows across the Thornwood.
The warrens beneath the Heartroot have been unsealed. Whatever nests there is feeding the Choir.
An old Vaelin hunter hid a cache somewhere east of the Heartroot. Rumor says it was never found.
The briars creep closer to Lisswen every night, and the Bramblelings with them. The Covenant remembers those who help.
Reef snappers are nesting on the beaches and cutting the nets.
Those touched by the Lattice can seek its Trial and walk a specialized path. The trial lies beneath the Nine Sisters.
Ships vanish off the Saltreach coast. Sailors speak of a bell ringing under the waves.
The Greywatch light went dark the night the bell started ringing. Rekindle it.
The drowned walk the tideline at dusk, still looking for their ships. Give them rest and the Tidewardens will owe you.
The Merrow's Due went down with a full hold. Find the wreck and the ledger.
The map leads to the Cinderreach, where the Emberwatch keeps a lonely vigil.
Ember hounds hunt our supply lines. Cull the packs.
The black glass of the Scar holds echoes of the Cinder Fall. Read them for me.
The Choir is forging a key from the Cinder Fall's heart. Destroy the forge.
The Choir sends new faces into the ash every day. Thin them out before they reach the wall.

Ranger Boots. They know the road even when you don't.
Linen Robe. It still beats, faintly, when the cinders fall.
Stiletto. Two bites from one mouth.
Nasal Helm. Worn by the last king of Kaldris, who would not stay dead.
Bearded Axe. The axe remembers every wound.
Hunter's Crossbow. Every bolt comes home, as every tide does.

Moonstone Ring. It never warms, however long you wear it.
Executioner's Blade. Forged to bring down the Spire itself.

Codex of Embers. The pages are wet. They never dry.
